bug_description.original: OSS-Fuzz issue 42474170 (capstonenext): Use-of-uninitialized-value found by fuzz target fuzz_disasmnext [msan]. https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/42474170
bug_description.normalized: The ARM instruction mapping table (ARMMappingInsn.inc) is missing an entry for internal opcode ARM_t__brkdiv0 (3216). When the decoder produces this opcode, ARM_get_insn_id calls insn_find which returns 0, skipping initialization of insn->id and insn->detail fields. The uninitialized insn->id is subsequently read in ARM_post_printer when comparing against insn_update_flgs entries, triggering a use-of-uninitialized-value detected by MemorySanitizer.

source.description: Heap allocation of cs_insn array via malloc (not calloc), leaving all fields including insn->id uninitialized.
source.value_from: cs_mem_malloc (= malloc) returns uninitialized heap memory for the cs_insn array

sink.description: Read of uninitialized insn->id in a comparison, detected by MSan.

root_cause.description: When insn_find returns 0 (opcode not found in mapping table), the function skips setting insn->id entirely. The mapping table lacks ARM_t__brkdiv0 (opcode 3216), so insn->id remains uninitialized for that opcode.

tainted_value_origin.description: The cs_insn struct is heap-allocated via malloc without zeroing; the id field carries indeterminate bits.

parser_admitted.description: handle->disasm successfully decodes input bytes into mci.Opcode, entering the instruction-mapping and printing path.

coarse_trace.summary: Allocates cs_insn array via malloc (uninitialized), then enters the disassembly loop. Calls ARM_get_insn_id to map internal opcode to public insn ID.
Looks up mci.Opcode in the insns mapping table via insn_find. For opcode 3216 (ARM_t__brkdiv0, absent from table), insn_find returns 0, so insn->id is never assigned.
Reads insn->id to compare against insn_update_flgs entries. Since insn->id was never initialized, MSan reports use-of-uninitialized-value.

fine_trace.note: Allocates sizeof(cs_insn)*cache_size bytes via malloc. Fields of each cs_insn (including id) are uninitialized.
Calls ARM_get_insn_id with mci.Opcode = 3216 (ARM_t__brkdiv0, produced by decoder from PoC bytes 0xf9de). insn_cache points into the malloc'd array; insn_cache->id is still uninitialized.
id=3216 exceeds insns[max-1].id=3215 (ARM_tUXTH, the last entry in the mapping table). Returns 0 immediately — no mapping found.
insn_find returned i=0. The conditional body that assigns insn->id=insns[i].mapid and initializes detail fields is skipped. insn->id remains uninitialized.
Calls ARM_post_printer with insn whose id field is still uninitialized (MCInst_getOpcodePub(mci)==0 at line 531, so the alias path does not set insn->id either).
Reads uninitialized insn->id for comparison. MSan detects use-of-uninitialized-value here.

poc.trigger: 3-byte input: byte 0 (0x03) selects ARM THUMB mode (platform index 3 mod 46); bytes 1-2 (0xf9 0xde) decode to internal opcode 3216 (ARM_t__brkdiv0), which is absent from the instruction mapping table, leaving insn->id uninitialized.

format.name: raw binary (libFuzzer corpus entry)
format.contract: Exactly 3 bytes: 0x03 0xf9 0xde. First byte selects the THUMB platform; remaining bytes encode a Thumb instruction that decodes to the unmapped ARM_t__brkdiv0 opcode.
